title: A geometric reformulation and structure-preserving rotational discrete gradient scheme for the full Ericksen-Leslie model
summary: In this paper, we present a structure-preserving rotational discrete gradient method of the full Ericksen-Leslie model for nematic liquid crystal flows with general anisotropic Oseen-Frank elasticity and full Leslie stress. The main difficulty resides in preserving both the pointwise unit-length constraint on the director field and the energy-dissipation at the discrete level, which involves high nonlinearities in the interplay between the length constraint, anisotropic elastic energy, and hydrodynamic couplings.
